image_description: A wall-mounted pipe organ installed in a room with a patterned ceiling. The organ features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, housed within an ornate wooden case with decorative moldings. A black metal railing runs along the bottom front of the instrument.

The black metal railing at the bottom merges indistinctly with the lower pipes and the wall. Some vertical lines of the railing seem to fade or warp into the background without clear structural logic.
